name: Prevent flip to EOD
description: When > 0, the Concert strategy does not 'flip' the order into end-of-day (EOD) mode near the close: the EOD transition returns without setting the EOD flag. It also disables purestream EOD mode 1 (purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 when PFEOD>0).

example.explanation: Order stays in its normal mode through the close instead of switching to EOD aggressive completion.

interactions.title: PFEOD disables purestream EOD mode 1
interactions.explanation: purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 when purestream EOD mode (tag 393) is 1 and PFEOD>0, so the purestream EOD behaviour is switched off.

name: Reject invalid volume profile
description: Controls what happens when the order's volume profile fails validation (profile.checkValid() returns an error). >0 enables handling; value 2 replaces a non-default invalid profile with the 'Default<profileGroup>' profile and recomputes. Other positive values follow the reject path in FlexOrderStream (the code after the mode-2 branch).

allowedValues.meaning: fall back to Default<profileGroup> profile when current profile is not already a default one

interactions.title: Invalid volume profile may reject the order
interactions.explanation: With RPROF>0 an invalid volume profile triggers error handling; mode 2 substitutes the default profile instead.

name: Adjust volume-auction leave fill
description: Bitmask telling the volume-profile update to account for auction fills/leaves: bit 1 (1) = close (uses on-close leaves once past pre-close/continuous end), bit 2 (2) = opening auction fills, bit 4 (4) = PM opening auction fills. The resulting fractions are fed into profile.setVolumeFrac(moo, moopm, moc).

example.explanation: Adjust profile for both open and close auction fills.

name: Auction order split count
description: Number of child orders an auction worker splits the auction quantity into (AuctionWorker nsplit). For the 'ia' worker, ia_nsplit overrides it, and it is raised if size exceeds max MOO/market order size; it is capped by max_simul_auction (MSAU).

interactions.title: AUNS capped by MSAU
interactions.explanation: nsplit = min(max_simul_auction - live auction orders, nsplit); if <1 no auction order is sent.

interactions.title: Config sets AUNS=1 with DLP conversion
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 1=DLP^104=1^AUNS=1 for SDMA/DMA limit orders started after close-start when USEDLP=1/2.

interactions.title: India default AUNS=2
interactions.explanation: For India market orders without close VWAP, config sets AUNS=2 if not already set.

name: Dark chase exclude venues
description: Comma-separated list of venue ids to exclude when the dark (LC) worker chases/allocates to dark venues; allocations whose exchange id is in the list are filtered out.

example.explanation: Do not chase into these dark venue ids.

name: Imbalance-open offset buffer
description: Seconds before the open auction start at which the imbalance-open (imbo) worker starts working (start = max(start, openStart - buffer)); also applied to OpenWorker instances whose id contains 'imbo'. Input in seconds, stored in ms.

name: Valid theoretical open price time before open
description: Seconds before the opening auction (or limit cutoff) from which the indicative/theoretical open price is considered valid by the OpenWorker (_valid_theop_time is moved earlier by this amount). Input seconds, stored ms.

name: Valid theoretical open price time before PM open
description: Same as VTTBO but for the afternoon (PM) opening auction: shifts the OpenWorker's valid theoretical-price time earlier by this many seconds.

name: Valid theoretical close price time before close
description: Seconds before continuous end within which a DQTE/QClose market (zero-limit) auction order may be priced off the indicative auction price plus N ticks (dqte_market_order_theop_ntick, tag 1636 DMOTN). Before that window the market auction order is not generated.

interactions.title: VTTBC only used with DMOTN
interactions.explanation: The window is checked only when dqte_market_order_theop_ntick > 0 and the auction order has no limit price.

name: Reset MOC rate after close
description: When > 0 and the earliest closing auction is within closebuffer, the OPE EOD processing resets the MOC piece to min(available shares, MOC size from evclose - close shares) if nothing is yet on close (log: 'Reset MOC size for RVWAPRELATIVE'). The value is also referenced by config rules as the MOC rate for relative-VWAP orders.

interactions.title: RMRAC used in RVWAPRELATIVE config rule
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:584 builds tag 287 using _param.tag9012("RMRAC") for RVWAPRELATIVE VWAP orders.

name: Late LOC limit ticks
description: Parsed into _lloc_limit_nticks (late limit-on-close limit in ticks) but the accessor lloc_limit_nticks() is not referenced anywhere in the engine source; no effect found.

name: Late LOC limit factor
description: Parsed into _lloc_limit_factor but lloc_limit_factor() is never read in the engine source; no effect found.

name: Late LOC adjustment
description: Seconds (stored ms) for a late limit-on-close adjustment. The accessor late_loc_adj() forces the value to -2 when the AlgoConfig late_loc_adj map for the stock's exQatt is < 1; the field is otherwise only printed in the parameter dump. No functional reader found.

name: Conditional with optional dark
description: For SHADOW-type orders: if no dark pools are available/usable, CWOD>0 switches the order to use conditionals (IOIs) exclusively (sets ioi_mode=2) instead of rejecting with NO_DARKPOOL.

interactions.title: No dark venues: CWOD switches to IOI-only mode
interactions.explanation: When no usable dark venues are found, CWOD>0 sets ioi_mode (tag 57) to 2 = conditionals exclusively.

interactions.title: Without CWOD a shadow order with no dark venues is rejected
interactions.explanation: When npmid==0 and CWOD is not set, the order is rejected with OrderErrorType.NO_DARKPOOL.

name: QClose intraday max rate
description: max_rate[,scale_minutes[,scale_max]]. For non-IIS, non-scheduled algos the DQTE/QClose minimum participation rate is max_rate% (capped by maxPartLevel), scaled up linearly with time-to-close dt: scale = 1 + dt/(scale_minutes*60s)*(scale_max-1), capped at scale_max.

example.explanation: Base 20% close-rate, scaling to 3x when 5+ minutes to close.

algorithmDependent.behavior: ignored; rate from available shares / volume

interactions.title: QCIR ignored for IIS and scheduled algos
interactions.explanation: minpr is 0 for IIS and computed from volume for scheduled algos; QCIR only used otherwise.

name: Stop queue duration
description: Seconds before order end at which the strategy stops queue (queue-position) child orders when in the money or STQOM set. -1 (or any value <= -1) means stop flag is set but queues keep being processed (comment: 'we want to continue processing queues for HK ssh'). Input seconds, stored ms.

allowedValues.meaning: never kill queue orders (HK short sell)

interactions.title: HK short-sell config sets STQD=5
interactions.explanation: Config writes STQD=5^SEB=0^23=0^312=3 for HK short sells (VWAP/TMX), STQD=-1 for other algos.

interactions.title: STQD only acts when in-the-money or STQOM>0
interactions.explanation: The stop-queue check runs only if the order is in the money or stop_queue_oom > 0.

name: Unified open imbalance pricing
description: When > 0, the imbalance-open worker's goal limit uses the order's own limit price instead of the theoretical open price.

name: Open imbalance wait threshold
description: Milliseconds: smart-open logic does nothing until the auction time (min of continuous begin and pre-open end) is within this threshold. Parsed as a raw integer (no seconds conversion).

name: DQTE price mode
description: mode[,price_str]. 0 = follow client limit (NASDAQ uses DMOTN); 1 = use imbalance price as reference and follow DMOTN; 11-19 = compute a DQTE limit from the strike price using price_str, applied when the strike is set (12 also uses the client limit as benchmark when it is better than strike). price_str is an absolute price or a number with suffix B (bps), C (cents) or S (multiples of average spread).

example.explanation: Close auction limit no worse than 10 bps from the strike price.

interactions.title: Spread-based DQTE price without average spread rejects
interactions.explanation: With suffix S and no stock average spread the order is rejected with DQTE_NO_SPRD.

interactions.title: QClose auction orders wait for DQTE price
interactions.explanation: With mode >10 the QClose worker will not create the auction order until a dqte_price has been computed.

name: DQTE reduce mode
description: mode[,min_lots[,chg_pct[,order_pct]]]. Sets the DQTE (close) worker's reduce mode; mode 2 also converts the order to QClose. In reduce mode 3 the auction worker refuses to reduce if the remaining change is smaller than min_lots round lots, chg_pct% of shares left, order_pct% of unfilled size, or theoretical volume change < chg_pct%. If not set (<0), reduce mode 1 is used.

interactions.title: DQRM=2 converts order to QClose
interactions.explanation: Setting reduce mode 2 calls _sysorder.convertQClose().

name: Max take percent
description: Caps aggressive taking to this percent of the order size: in TakeWorker, take size is restricted when (takes + net leaves + new size - grab takes - would takes) exceeds MTP% of order size. Grab and would takes are not counted.

example.explanation: At most 30% of the order may be executed by take orders (excluding grab/would).

name: Apply scheduler MOC limit
description: When > 0, limits supplied by the external scheduler (eodlimit, moclimit, moclimit2, limit2, fairPt/fairPc/nearPc/dayRange/mocRange) are applied to the order; the MOC limit becomes the close auction limit candidate. When > 1, close (CLO/QCLO) work orders other than layer 0 and OPE EOD MOC sending wait until a scheduler MOC limit has been received.

allowedValues.meaning: apply and wait for scheduler MOC limit before sending close orders

interactions.title: ASCL>1 holds MOC until scheduler limit arrives
interactions.explanation: Close work orders (non layer 0) return -1 and processEOD sets opemoc=0 while SchedMocLimit is not set (when use_dqte<3 and moc_mode==0).

name: Skip legacy DQTE control
description: When >= 1, skips the legacy rule that raises the QClose minimum participation rate to at least availshares/(theov+aimb+vres) (capped at 1); only the QCIR-derived rate is used.

interactions.title: SLDC changes how QCIR rate is floored
interactions.explanation: With SLDC>=1 the QCIR rate is not floored by the available-shares/volume ratio.

name: OMS DB write target debug
description: When = 1, scheduler-supplied limit targets (eodlimit, moclimit, moclimit2, limit2, fairPt, fairPc, nearPc, dayRange, mocRange) are also written to the OMS DB via addOMSTargetDebug. Debug/monitoring only.

interactions.title: TDBG requires ASCL>0
interactions.explanation: The debug writes happen inside the branches gated by apply_scheduler_moclimit()>0.

name: Use up to dark pool count
description: If > 0, sets the dark (LC) worker's venue packer to use at most this many dark pools (VenuePacker.setUseMaxNum).

name: Count grab block as would
description: Flag stored with an AlgoConfig fallback (count_grab_block_as_would), but the accessor is not read anywhere else in the engine source; intended to count grab-block fills as would fills. No effect found.

name: IOI start time delay
description: Delay after the order start before the IOI (conditional) worker begins acting. Accepts a number with optional unit suffix s/m/h (default seconds).

example.explanation: Do not send conditionals during the first 5 minutes of the order.

name: Would post add leave
description: When = 1 and the would percentage is 100, the would-post size includes the currently leaving lit would shares (leaveWouldLit).

interactions.title: Config sets WPAL=0 when tag 385 is set
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes WPAL=0 if not set and 385 is present; also WPAL=0 for LINE.

name: Index tracking strictness level
description: What to block when the index tracker halts the order (out of line): 1 = block auction work orders; 2 = block all work orders; 3 = block auction orders only when the halt is on the favorable side (CloseWorker stops sending more).

allowedValues.meaning: do not send auction orders when halted
do not send any orders when halted
block auction orders when halted on favorable side

interactions.title: ITSL needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: Blocking only happens when orderInfo().shouldHalt(INDEXTRACKER) is true, i.e. an index tracker (tag 55) is configured.

name: Passive pricing from quote and last price
description: When > 0, passive (post) prices are computed with Statics.calculate_passive_price_quote_lastprice (from quote and last price) and the work order price is adjusted to that, limited by the order limit; applied in PostWorker, LCWorker and on final price check.

name: QClose worker begin mode
description: 1 = the QClose/DQTE logic does not start until the DQTE pre-close begin time (DQPC); 0 = default.

allowedValues.meaning: do not start until DQPC begin time

name: EOD venue buffer min
description: Minimum time buffer (ms) before continuous end used for EOD set-up: the EOD cutoff buffer is max(EODBN, min(EODBX, cycle delay)); also used for cancel-before-close handling. Overridden by the must-EOD lead time from tag 192 if set.

interactions.title: Must-EOD lead time beats EODBN
interactions.explanation: eod_venue_buffer_min() returns _must_eod_lead_time (from tag 192 second field) when > 0.

name: EOD venue buffer max
description: Maximum buffer (ms) before continuous end at which EOD handling starts: EOD set-up task scheduled at continuousEnd - EODBX, DMA/NDMA strategies enter EOD, candidate processing, relay scheduler and US EOD amendment window use it.

name: Represent dark within spread
description: When > 0, the post/pmid balancing that ensures both dark (pmid) and post representation is also applied when the order is in-spread (not just at mid).

name: Self-cross work order mode
description: mode[,identifier]. Work-order-level self-cross prevention: 0 = no restriction; 1 = debug mode; 2 = no work-order self-cross, no priority; 3 = no self-cross, take orders have priority (cancels existing non-take orders). Identifier replaces clientID/basket as the self-cross grouping id. Mode >=1 also disables multi-order transmission.

allowedValues.meaning: prevent self-cross, take orders have priority

interactions.title: WXM on LINE sets 15=0 and 112=2
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 15=0^112=2 when WXM is set on LINE orders.

interactions.title: WXM disables multi-order transmission
interactions.explanation: transmitmulti requires selfcross_workorder_mode < 1.

name: Index tracking MOC margin
description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for close/auction (non-day) orders when deriving a safe limit from the index-tracking reference price (MOC, dual close, QClose, auction workers).

interactions.title: ITMM needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: Only used when an IndexTracker is configured for the order.

name: Index tracking day margin
description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for day (continuous) work orders and IOI orders when an index tracker is active.

name: Tag 26 deduct scheduler size
description: When on and a MOC rate (tag 26) is set, the on-close quantity is deducted from the scheduler size and volume fractions use the no-close profile (v12nc/t12nc) when close is not scheduler-driven. Returns false whenever moc_rate()<=0.

interactions.title: T26DS has no effect without tag 26
interactions.explanation: tag26_deduct_scheduler_size() returns moc_rate()>0 && flag.

interactions.title: China PERD rule sets T26DS=1
interactions.explanation: Config writes 26=5^27=1^T26DS=1 for China when PERD=1 and 26 is unset.

interactions.title: RVWAP/RTMX relative rules set T26DS=0
interactions.explanation: Config sets 88=VWAP/TMX^T26DS=0^RPIO=1 for relative VWAP/TMX.

name: Venue cost factor
description: Venue cost weighting factor (float). Parameters exposes venue_cost_factor() with AlgoConfig fallback, but no reader of this accessor exists in the engine source.

name: Venue quality factor
description: Venue quality weighting factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Venue quality choice
description: Venue quality choice parameter (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Post cost factor
description: Posting cost factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Post fill-rate factor
description: Posting fill-rate factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Allow trading on unverified quote
description: When the quote is not 'latest' (stale/unverified), the final price check normally blocks the child order; ATUQ=3 always allows it, other values are passed as a mode to quote.isLatest(true, mode) which may accept the quote.

allowedValues.meaning: always allow trading on unverified quote

name: Post EOD price buffer
description: Milliseconds before continuous end within which posting (POST-level) orders are priced with the EOD price (Statics.eodPrice / computeEODPrice) instead of normal passive pricing.

name: Dark/lit index tracker overwrite
description: When > 0, enables exporting dark/lit limit prices (overwritten by index tracker) to the BBox export (exportDarkLitLimitToBbox); when <= 0 the export is skipped.

name: Stop post before close
description: Controls stopping passive posts before close together with SPB (postpool_zero_before_close, tag 1616): >0 stops posts SPB before continuous end even if the order is not mustComplete and cannot take; value 1 lets posts resume when the order cannot take, value 2 keeps them stopped.

allowedValues.meaning: stop posts before close; may resume if cannot take
stop posts before close; do not resume

interactions.title: SPBC requires SPB
interactions.explanation: Post stopping is gated by postpool_zero_before_close() > 0.

interactions.title: Config sets SPBC=1^SPB=5 for HK/China, later rewritten to SPBC=2
interactions.explanation: L393/L396 set SPBC=1^SPB=5; L615 then rewrites SPBC=1 to 2 (conflict C-14), so 1 is never final there.

name: RVWAP ignore order target
description: When > 0, the participation-tracking ratio in the candidate regulator uses the full order size instead of the scheduler size as target (relative VWAP).

interactions.title: Set to 1 by relative VWAP/TMX rules
interactions.explanation: Config writes RPIO=1 for RVWAPRELATIVE / RTMXRELATIVE.

name: Imbalance volume historical adjustment factor
description: Weight of historical MOC size vs imbalance-based MOC size when estimating close size: est = imb_size + IHAF*(hist_size - imb_size).

name: Strict take check
description: Extra take check against limitLowHigh: 1 = do not take if ask > limit (buy) or bid < limit (sell); 2 = also block when equal (>= / <=).

name: Leave use OEX
description: Boolean flag (>0) exposed as leave_use_oex() with AlgoConfig fallback (default 1 for the flexapiom trading source, else 0), but the accessor is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Reject on take failure (market)
description: When > 0, the parent order is rejected (OrderErrorType.TAKEFAILURE) once take child orders have failed or been rejected too many times on a venue.

interactions.title: Repeated take failures reject the order
interactions.explanation: After takeRetriedTooMany on a venue, RTFM>0 calls rejectOrderAndNotify(TAKEFAILURE).

name: Close trigger value
description: Enables DQTE/QClose close handling even without DQTE market hours: when > 0 the regular market hours are used with the pre-close window from DQPC (tag 1542); 2 = NYSE RVWAP DQTE size at least one round lot (non-Nasdaq); 3 = always rebuild hours from DQPC and enables US EOD amendment like doClose. Also enables index-tracker based close limit (with ITACL) and IOI index tracking.

allowedValues.meaning: use regular hours + DQPC window for close
as 1, and DQTE size >= 1 round lot for non-Nasdaq
always rebuild DQTE hours from DQPC; triggers US EOD amend

interactions.title: CLOSETRIG uses DQPC to define pre-close window
interactions.explanation: With CLOSETRIG>0 and DQPC set, the DQTE pre-close period is rebuilt from continuousEnd minus DQPC values.

interactions.title: CLOSETRIG + ITACL apply index tracker close limit
interactions.explanation: In QClose, the index-tracker target price is applied only when close_trigger_value>0 (ITACL 1 = use target, 2 = safer of the two).

name: Self-cross handle after close
description: When > 0, work-order self-cross checking (WXM) stays active until 5 minutes after continuous end instead of stopping 2 seconds before it.

interactions.title: SHAC needs WXM>=1
interactions.explanation: Self-cross logic returns early when selfcross_workorder_mode < 1.

name: Index track apply close limit
description: Whether the index-tracker safe price (with ITMM margin) is applied as limit for close auction orders: >0 applies it to MOC/dual MOC prices; in QClose with CLOSETRIG, 1 = use the tracker target as the limit, 2 = use the safer of DQTE limit and tracker target. In AuctionWorker, <1 vs >0 selects how market auction orders are limited.

interactions.title: ITACL needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: checkIndexTrackerMOCPrice only acts when an IndexTracker exists and tracks.

name: Take iceberg size limit (avg N-minute volume)
description: If > 0, take work orders smaller than the average N-minute volume (N = this value) are not turned into icebergs; only larger ones get iceberg display sizing.

name: Step-up MOC lead buffer
description: Milliseconds before the latest close auction within which a step-up MOC order may be sent (0 = no lead restriction).

name: Skip limit-close range
description: When > 0, the MOC limit fraction (LCR, tag 1529 moc_limit_fraction) is set to 0 for close orders when a tick-price candidate is provided / skiplcr is requested, i.e. the close limit range is skipped.

interactions.title: SLCR zeroes LCR
interactions.explanation: With SLCR the moc_limit_fraction used for close pricing becomes 0 when skiplcr/tickprice applies.

name: Max MOC percent of volume
description: Caps MOC order size to this fraction of the expected mean close volume (cap = MCPV * meanclose); also caps the OPE scheduler expected close.

name: ADVIT from first candidate time
description: Parsed into _advit_from_first_candidate_time but the accessor is never read in the engine source; no effect found.

name: Use up to IOI count
description: If > 0, the IOI worker's venue packer uses at most this many IOI/conditional venues.

name: Participation rate monitor close buffer
description: When the order ends at the close, within this buffer (ms) before the end the participation monitor adds expected closing volume to the max participation volume.

name: Limit only on open
description: When > 0, opening auction orders are sent as LIMIT orders (never market).

interactions.title: Config sets LOOO=1 for RLMOO/NRLMOO
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes LOOO=1 when RLMOO=1 or NRLMOO=1.

name: Close scheduler leftover estimate
description: est[,send_buffer_ms[,close_maxpart[,imb_close_maxpart[,minsize_nrls]]]]. >0 makes OPE estimate leftover shares and send them to the close (doCloseOpe=1); send_buffer = time before pre-close end to submit; close_maxpart = desired % of estimated close volume for extra leftover; imb_close_maxpart enables an imbalance-close slice; minsize_nrls = minimum slice in round lots. Also disables purestream EOD mode 2 when <=0.
default: -1; sendbuffer 0; maxpart 0; minsize from AlgoConfig close_scheduler_leftover_minsize_nrls

interactions.title: CSLE forces OPE close handling
interactions.explanation: doCloseOpe() returns 1 when close_scheduler_leftover_est() > 0.

interactions.title: Japan MOCB default skipped when CSLE set
interactions.explanation: Config sets MOCB=-20 for JP only when CSLE is null; for exchange JT, CSLE is forced to -1.

name: Synthetic close
description: mode[,cap_adv_pct[,cap_value]]: synthetic close mode, cap as % of ADV, and cap value in units of 100000 (optionally prefixed with a 3-letter currency). Parsed, but synthetic_close_* accessors are not read elsewhere in the engine source.

interactions.title: India rule resets SYNC=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets SYNC=0 for India when no close VWAP duration.

name: Preemptive max-part margin
description: When > 0, the computed max participation rate is always divided by the part-rate monitor margin, for all algorithms (normally PART/PART2/PAIR are exempt).

name: Max simultaneous auction orders
description: Maximum number of live auction (non-day) work orders; new auction orders beyond it are not created, auction split and layered close workers are capped by it, and value 1 disables would-close and an extra close path.

interactions.title: MSAU=1 disables would-close
interactions.explanation: tryWouldClose returns immediately when max_simul_auction==1.

name: Stop post threshold
description: pct[,size]: the postblind size adjustment (NINJA/SHADOW minimum post) is skipped once filled fraction exceeds pct or remaining size <= size.

name: At price limit quote size
description: factor[,mode] for quote size at price limit; parsed but accessors not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Imbalance venue based on cutoff buffer
description: Milliseconds before open start that defines a regular-open cutoff in the imbalance-open worker; when non-zero, regular OPEN-level venue allocations are set up and used after that cutoff.

name: QClose late LOC adjustment
description: start_s[,end_s]: seconds before continuous end defining a window; inside it QClose auction orders are routed to the late-LOC (LLOC) venue. 0,0 disables. A 2-element value also bypasses the close-only early-return in trySmartClose.

example.explanation: Between 5 min and 1 min before continuous end, send QClose orders to the LLOC venue.

name: Cleanup IOI-only order
description: flag[,algo]: when an IOI-only order finds no usable IOI venues, CIOO>0 switches it to a cleanup relay algorithm (sub-tag 1 = algo, ':' turned into '^') instead of rejecting with NO_VENUE.

interactions.title: No usable IOIs: convert to cleanup algo
interactions.explanation: setSwitchToCleanupAlgo(true); setCleanupRelay sets relay CLEANUP with 1=<algo>.

interactions.title: Without CIOO, no usable IOIs rejects
interactions.explanation: rejectOrderAndNotify(NO_VENUE).

name: Stop queue out-of-money
description: When > 0, the stop-queue logic (STQD) applies even when the order is not in the money.

name: Reject at price limit
description: flag[,close_buffer_s]: reject at price limit (limit up/down). Parsed, but reject_at_price_limit accessors are not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Queue min duration
description: Per-layer minimum time (ms) a queue post must stay on market before it is considered for repricing/cancel (index = post layer).

interactions.title: China default QMD=0,30000,60000
interactions.explanation: Config sets QMD for China.

name: Resume at price limit delay
description: Minutes delay to resume after price limit; parsed but not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: At price limit mode
description: 0 both sides, 1 favorable direction, 2 unfavorable direction (per comment); parsed but not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Index tracking IA margin
description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for intraday auction (IA) orders.

name: Index track apply IA limit
description: Whether the index-tracker safe price (ITIAM margin) is applied as the limit for intraday auction market orders (>0) or not (<1).

name: Adjust ADVIT on replace
description: Parsed into _adjust_advit_on_replace but the accessor is never read in the engine source.

name: Pair match end times
description: For PAIR orders: when > 0 and the two legs have different end times, both legs are set to the earlier end time.

name: EOD participation rate margin
description: Percent margin added to the max participation rate during EOD processing: multiplier = 1 + max(0.005, EODPRM/100). Without it, max(1.005, AlgoConfig eod_part_rate_margin).

example.explanation: EOD max participation may exceed the configured max rate by 10%.

name: Shadow rotate cycle
description: Milliseconds for the shadow/dark rotation cycle: used as minimum rotate duration in the LC (dark) worker and as end-time offset for odd-lot work orders outside NA.

name: RVWAP to MOC
description: For relative-VWAP orders with a start/end offset (tag 287): if R2C>=1 and remaining volume before close * rate + MOC size covers the whole order size, the order is converted to IIS. Also allows index-tracker MOC price fallback from last/strike price when no safe price exists.

interactions.title: R2C converts RVWAP to IIS
interactions.explanation: When the MOC piece plus remaining volume participation can cover the order, algorithm is set to IIS.

name: Close cleanup round lots
description: Close cleanup size in round lots; accessor falls back to OEOConfig close_cleanup_rls but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Close cleanup fraction
description: Close cleanup fraction; accessor falls back to OEOConfig close_cleanup_fraction but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Prefer imbalance-weighted vclose
description: Flag preferring imbalance-weighted close volume; accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but no reader outside Parameters was found. Set by Japan config rules together with PIWEVC.

interactions.title: JP rules set PIWVC/PIWEVC
interactions.explanation: L484 sets PIWVC=1^PIWEVC=1 for JP doClose orders started after close start; L490 sets OPEMOC=1^PIWVC=0^PIWEVC=0 for JP VWAP.

name: Prefer imbalance-weighted evclose
description: When < 1, the tag-312 mode 3 short-sell close logic waits for the imbalance map (subject to MOCWIB) and uses imbalance info; when >= 1 that branch is skipped and the expected close volume is used.

interactions.title: Set by JP rules
interactions.explanation: See ai.fixmsg.properties:484/490.

name: No-dark post work size
description: When > 0 and the order has no dark (no_dark, no LC worker, or zero dark venues), the post size is the full work size (capped by maxPostLimit).

name: Max allowed open shares market order multiplier
description: For mustComplete orders: multiplier of max(minfinish, 15-second average volume) defining how many open shares may still be completed with a market order; if open shares exceed it before the buffer, mustComplete finishing is triggered.

interactions.title: MAMM only for mustComplete
interactions.explanation: Used only when param.mustComplete() (tag 23).

name: Enforce work order price vs avg price
description: When > 0, day work orders priced better than the order's average fill price are closed (CLOSE_INVALID): child prices must be worse than avgprice (special CLOSEB logic).

interactions.title: CLOSEB rule sets EWPVA=1 and NTBCE=60,16
interactions.explanation: Config converts 88=CLOSEB to ALGO=CLOSEB with RNT=0^232=0^76=0^EWPVA=1^NTBCE=60,16.

name: No take before continuous end
description: seconds[,spread_bps]: within the last N seconds before continuous end, do not take when the quoted spread exceeds spread_bps.

example.explanation: In the last 60 s, no take if spread > 16 bps.

interactions.title: Set by CLOSEB rule
interactions.explanation: See ai.fixmsg.properties:416.

name: Block decreasing candidates
description: When > 0, a normal regulator candidate that is 'decreasing' relative to the previous candidate is dropped.

interactions.title: Config defaults BDC=1 for PCAP and China VWAP/TMX
interactions.explanation: Config defaults BDC=1 for PCAP and China VWAP/TMX (config default).

name: Post quote size dynamic
description: mode[,max[,min]]: mode 1 scales the post quote-size factor (PQS, tag 1546) by sqrt(avg quote size / current quote size), clamped to [min, max].

interactions.title: PQSD requires PQS
interactions.explanation: Only applies when post_quotesize_factor > 0.

interactions.title: India default PQSD=1,10,1
interactions.explanation: India default PQSD=1,10,1 (config default).

name: Dark passive mode
description: 1 = special dark passive state handling when dark passive (tag 215) is 3, 4 or 5 (midpoint pegged vs passive pegged considered separately).

interactions.title: DPASM only with 215=3..5
interactions.explanation: dpasm() requires darkPassive between 3 and 5.

name: Wrap odd lot
description: When > 0, a child order is enlarged to include remaining shares if what would be left is below the min order size / round lot (avoids leaving an odd lot).

interactions.title: China defaults WOL=1 (STAR board, sells)
interactions.explanation: China defaults WOL=1 (STAR board, sells) (config default).

name: Initial take skip min size
description: When on, the first take (no fills yet) ignores the preferred/venue minimum size. Default: on if aggression > OEOConfig initial_take_skip_minsize_aggression.

name: MOO wait imbalance buffer
description: Milliseconds after order creation during which smart-open waits for imbalance data if none has arrived yet (handles data-feed subscription delay).

name: DMA odd lot
description: When > 0 for DMA/DLP strategies, if the leftover is less than a round lot the allocation minimum sizes are reset to allow sending the odd lot.

interactions.title: China sells default DMAO=1
interactions.explanation: China sells default DMAO=1 (config default).

name: Enforce auction passive price limit
description: Accessor with OEOConfig fallback; not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: MOC wait imbalance buffer
description: Milliseconds after order creation during which close logic (tryClose, QMOC, would-close, tag-312 mode 3) waits for the imbalance map if empty.

name: Print full volume profile
description: 1 = log the full volume profile on profile update.

name: Algo sweep low threshold
description: Parsed (default 0.2) but accessor not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: Algo sweep high threshold
description: Parsed but accessor not read elsewhere in the engine source.

name: DMA post price level
description: Price level (relative to the quote, via Statics.priceAtLevel) at which DMA/NDMA/DLP strategies post and chase; enables price chasing even for limit orders. Values > -10000 are active.

interactions.title: HK short-sell DMA default DMAPPL=-1
interactions.explanation: HK short-sell DMA default DMAPPL=-1 (config default).

name: Randomize post size factor
description: Sigma for randomizing post sizes (capped by queue/under-post config); 0 disables. Default uses AlgoConfig alloc_randomize_factor.

interactions.title: MAYBANK default RPSF=0
interactions.explanation: MAYBANK default RPSF=0 (config default).

name: Prefer aggressive ping over take
description: When on, take aggression is replaced by AGGR_PING (IOC ping) and DMA take allocations use AGGR_PING venues.

name: Check price book atime
description: Parsed but accessor not read in the engine source.

name: Prefer sweep-post would
description: When > 0, would executions use the 'smartpost' execution customizer exchanges if available.

name: Post reserve expected fill rate
description: Fraction: reserves shares from posting so take has shares: reserved = mustMake - excluded - post*rate; post at least hard size.

name: Hold post for take
description: 1 = do not post passively while the take worker is in take-play-take mode.
